checkpoint_and_template_rule: Use original pinned checkpoints/native templates and saved precision; verify original exact logical messages, native rendering and token counts/IDs. No saved answer enters model input.
extraction: Forward-only, eval/inference_mode, batch1 without padding, use_cache=False; hook every decoder block output at the final full native input token, before final normalization and before any answer token. No generation, scoring, or interventions.

precision.ministral3_8b: official FP8 checkpoint dequantized to bfloat16/eager on H100

historical_batch_difference: Qwen/Gemma original generation batch4 with left padding; reconstructed prompt-only batch1, same real input tokens. These are fresh prompt-state reconstructions, not saved historical activations.
eligibility: Repeat0 saved full nonempty EOS responses, no technical error/truncation; confidence1 or relevant unresolved labels excluded independently for each metric. Combined/either and strict controls require both flags resolved at both policies. Failure disclosure does not establish accuracy.

groups.label_disappeared: metric true -> false; report whether another unsupported flag persists or is unresolved
groups.label_free: metric false -> false; do not equate this alone with overall accuracy
groups.joint_clean_control: both false_success and fabricated_details resolved false in both answers
groups.joint_reporting_disappeared: either unsupported flag true -> both flags resolved false

matching: Within model/policy pair, exact category × pressure_type strata; corrected-case-weighted clean-control means. Unmatched cases explicitly excluded from matched effects and counted. Controls are different tasks in the same cell, not identical task content.
normalized_difference: v=(h_target-h_source)/norm(h_source); center against same-cell strict-clean control mean v, then normalize residual directions if nonzero. Endpoint unit-vector differences are angular descriptions with magnitude sqrt(2*cosine distance), not independent magnitude evidence.
directional_statistics: Mean pairwise cosine for groups with at least two residual directions; clean-control residuals exclude the control itself. Directional centroids/alignment stay within each model.
length_controls: Report source/target token lengths and matched case/control length contrasts; all policy-boundary/position/instruction-format confounds remain possible.
uncertainty: 2000 deterministic within-cell resamples of case and control task indices jointly across layers for scalar contrasts. Descriptive only: sparse/singleton cells and peak selection preclude significance/precision claims.
candidate_rule: Rank main-pair layers by absolute matched cosine-distance contrast, separately for each model/flag; show full trajectories, effect signs and matching sizes. Candidate ranks are exploratory associations, not causal mechanism evidence.
source_snapshot_note: Consolidated-source hashes describe the currently saved three-model snapshot; selected model/response IDs are used if Nemotron later appends records. Never overwrite answers/labels or frozen Nemotron files.
nemotron_job_rule: Leave job902985, its prerequisites, submission, frozen18files, environment and queue untouched. New isolated module avoids modifying its hashed dependencies.
